cron.heading: Daily job schedule
cron.loadError: Could not load the data. Please try again later.
cron.effective: The daily job starts once a day, at the first hourly ping at or after {utc} UTC ({bucharest} Bucharest time).
cron.defaultNote: No hour has been saved yet, so the default ({utc} UTC) is used.
cron.pingText: The job only starts when something calls /api/cron/daily with the CRON_SECRET bearer token at least once an hour. The repository includes a GitHub Actions workflow that does this every hour; see the README (“Daily ingestion (cron)”) for the two repository secrets to add.
cron.pingRule: A ping before the chosen hour does nothing; the first ping at or after it starts the job. The job starts at most once per UTC day: if a run already started today — even a failed one — later pings are skipped.
cron.safetyNet: Vercel also calls the job once a day at {utc} UTC as a safety net; the same rules apply.

Chat.heading: Configuration chat
Chat.intro: Change ETF and history-widget configuration with a short request, including up to five actions in one message.

instructions.heading: What you can ask
instructions.intro: You can combine one to five configuration and custom-value requests in a message:
instructions.trackField: Track an available field for an ETF.
instructions.untrackField: Stop tracking a field for an ETF.
instructions.widgetAdd: Add a custom history value using change, percent change, average, minimum or maximum over days or reports.
instructions.widgetUpdate: Update a custom history value for an ETF and slot.
instructions.widgetClear: Clear one custom history value or all custom values for an ETF.
instructions.widgetReplace: Replace custom history values for an ETF with a list of up to six definitions.
instructions.multiAction: Actions are checked before any changes are saved. Requests with more than five actions must be split.
instructions.setupQuestions: You can also ask setup questions, such as which ETFs are active, which fields are tracked, which custom values exist, or which AI provider and model are in use.
instructions.listExamples: List requests work too, for example: “list the active ETFs”, “which ETFs are inactive?”, “what fields does BTBETRETF track?”, “what custom values does BTBETRETF have?”, “what is the latest report date of each ETF?”. They are answered from the current configuration, never from report values.
instructions.conversation: The assistant remembers the last 21 messages, so you can refer back to what you just asked. Use "New conversation" to start over.
